'''Sard Nightbringer''' was the most powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the last years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], she struggled mightily against the bureaucracy of the Empire. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], she and her forces began taking back their sector, invading Imperial positions and removing the forces which controlled them. Her forces obtained a prototype personal shield generator from [[Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583]], which she tried to auction off to obtain funds for her organization. After [[Natja]] the Hutt was killed following her winning bid, [[Marg Sonat]] killed Nightbringer in order to take possession of the shield generator for himself.
